answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, with peers attesting to its work. A new identity starts on the horizon of trust with zero reputation: it can whisper offers but cannot settle large trades until its stake and completed jobs prove it. Reputation accrues slowly, like climbing a knoll, while one verified misdeed slashes the stake and wipes the score. A thousand fake identities means a thousand stakes locked, so forgery costs more than any fraud it could earn.
